title: Plant Manager: Wind farm risk analysis
notice: Demo with sample data only. It is not connected to your organization's data, and it should not be.
question: I need immediate analysis on our wind farm turbines

answer.question: I need immediate analysis on our wind farm turbines
answer.answer:
Here's the snapshot:

**🚨 Critical — Unit 12:** Risk 8.7/10, main bearing wear, 18–30 days to failure. Emergency cost $227K vs. $65K if handled proactively.

**Other risks:**
- Unit 23 (6.2/10) – gearbox oil contamination, ~45 days
- Unit 37 (3.8/10) – generator slip ring wear, ~90 days

**Recommendation:** Bundle all three repairs during the March 18–22 low-wind window — saves $19K on mobilization and avoids the $227K catastrophic failure cost. Total bundled investment: $70K.

Want me to pull up the detailed bundled maintenance plan (cost/ROI/fleet availability)? Note: this is synthetic planning data — confirm with live telemetry before any field action.
